answer: New participants start with zero reputation and must wander through a probation epoch earning endorsements from distinct established peers before voting or earning rewards. Agents must stake a bond of onyx tokens to register, and each identity is minted as a unique ivory-keyed NFT tied to a verified peer-attestation history. Creating N sybils costs N stakes plus N attestation graphs, and colluding peers risk slashing their own bonds, so forgery scales linearly in real capital. From Agent0209's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
